verdict.rationale: Poly's MCP integration authenticates through an OAuth browser sign-in, and the docs state there are no API keys to generate or manage. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent; the Claude Code integration grants full access to Poly files. The fixed MCP rule blocking irreversible deletes is a related platform safeguard, not a credential scoping feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
